cases: Same assertion before/on/after a proven effective date
oracle_requirement: Explicit validity interval and boundary policy
evaluation_rule: Group by underlying fact and change event

cases: One wrong atom among several independently verified atoms
evaluation_rule: Vary number/order of atoms without changing oracle

cases: Unsupported fact, contradicted fact, and parser failure as separate cases
oracle_requirement: Universe-level support/contradiction policy; parser failure is not a gold label
evaluation_rule: Report each source of uncertainty separately

cases: Pronouns, headings, aliases, nested product names
oracle_requirement: Human-reviewed extraction tied to explicit source context

cases: GB/MB; weeks/days; calendar durations; strict/inclusive bounds
oracle_requirement: Contract-defined dimensional conversions and boundary tests
evaluation_rule: Equality, below, at, and above boundary

cases: One-off/monthly/yearly; currencies; decimal formats; partial dates
oracle_requirement: Typed exact values and preserved precision
evaluation_rule: Never convert billing period or date precision silently

cases: Negated number vs boolean; not X but Y; conjunction scope
evaluation_rule: Keep lexical variants of a seed in one group

oracle_requirement: Version tuple semantics and protected entity spans
evaluation_rule: Check span boundaries and leading/trailing components

cases: Event-time lookup; changing link target; properties of a target
oracle_requirement: Explicit event dates and overlapping validity intervals

cases: All five claim types, invalid near-misses, duplicate full-input text
oracle_requirement: Local schemas plus documented phrase rules
evaluation_rule: Test text/form agreement and exactly 1,000 claims

cases: About 20,000 input rows under offline runtime limits
evaluation_rule: 2 CPUs, 6 GiB, 30 minutes; separate from this EDA
